# hostinger_vps_monarx (Resource)

Manages the Monarx malware scanner on a VPS virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostinger_vps_monarx" "example" {
  virtual_machine_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the VPS virtual machine.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean) Whether to wait for the Monarx action to complete before returning. Defaults to true.
